summary: Frontend-only verification of EnergyFlow Compact/Detail view toggle. All 5 requested scenarios PASSED. Compact mode does NOT crash — no page errors, no fallback to dashboard-loading. Detail mode restores 6 nodes. Auto persistence via localStorage works across in-app nav (Verlauf→Dashboard, aria-pressed='true' preserved). Mobile 390x844 in auto resolves to compact (flow-pv/grid/battery/house render), no horizontal overflow (docW=390=winW). Hover inspector on flow-pv in compact shows title 'PV-Block' with AC·Hoymiles and DC·Victron rows.

issues: Recharts console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — a ResponsiveContainer somewhere mounts with a zero-sized parent (likely a collapsed/hidden chart container). Non-blocking but should be investigated.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate Recharts width/height(-1) warning on initial Dashboard load — likely a ResponsiveContainer inside a hidden/collapsed element.
critical_code_review_comments: EnergyFlow.jsx is 540+ lines; consider splitting NodeCard/Flow/Emblems/Inspector into separate files per the file-size guideline.
View toggle correctly uses localStorage with try/catch (SSR-safe) and resize listener for narrow detection — clean implementation.
Flow filtering via `present` Set correctly guards against orphan flows when devices are disabled — robust against edge cases.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EnergyFlow toggle verified working. flow-view-auto/compact/detail buttons functional, aria-pressed reflects state, localStorage key 'solar.flowView' persists. Compact nodes: flow-pv, flow-grid, flow-battery, flow-house. Detail nodes: flow-mppt1, flow-mppt2, flow-hoymiles, flow-battery, flow-house, flow-grid. Hover inspector testid='flow-inspector', title='flow-inspector-title'. No crashes observed in any mode.
rca of the issue: No crash reproduced. The previously suspected compact-mode crash did not occur in 1920x900 or 390x844 viewports. Zero pageerrors captured during KOMPAKT click and after. Dashboard remained rendered (no fallback to data-testid='dashboard-loading'). Main agent's intermittent fallback was likely a Playwright click-timing/preview-flake issue rather than a real EnergyFlow render crash.
